modules.title: 文件里的一行 URL 怎样进入爬虫请求

items.title: 列出想让系统发现的地址
items.text: Sitemap 用 XML 组织完整 URL，适合列出网站希望爬虫发现的重要页面。清单里的地址应真实存在、能访问，并与页面选择的规范地址一致。

items.title: 发现之后仍要请求和判断
items.text: 爬虫读取清单后还会请求页面，检查能否访问并决定是否继续处理。Sitemap 增加发现机会，不替页面提供内容，也不替搜索系统做收录和排名决定。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: XML Sitemap 是给爬虫读取的机器文件；信息架构里的 sitemap 或网站导航是给人理解页面层级的可见结构。它也不是权限控制：公开列出一个 URL 不会授予访问权，未列出也不等于禁止访问。

lessonPractice.title: sitemap.xml 里列出了一条已经返回 404 的文章地址。应该怎样处理？

options.label: 修复文章地址或从 sitemap 中移除它，再验证清单里的 URL 都能访问
options.feedback: 对。Sitemap 应帮助爬虫找到重要且可访问的 URL，不能靠列出错误地址把不存在的页面变出来。

options.label: 保留这条地址，因为爬虫看到它后就会自动创建或收录文章
options.feedback: Sitemap 只提供发现线索，不创建资源，也不保证收录；404 地址反而给抓取带来错误信号。

options.label: 把它换成一个给访客看的文章目录页面，并把目录层级写完整
options.feedback: 可见目录是信息架构或网站导航，不是 XML Sitemap 的替代物；这里仍要处理机器清单中的错误 URL。

en.title: An entry in sitemap.xml points to an article URL that returns 404. What should you do?

options.label: Fix the article URL or remove it from the sitemap, then verify every listed URL is reachable
options.feedback: Correct. A sitemap should help crawlers find important reachable URLs; listing a broken address cannot create the missing page.

options.label: Keep it because a crawler will create or index the article after seeing the URL
options.feedback: A sitemap is a discovery hint, not a resource creator or an indexing guarantee. A 404 entry instead gives crawling an error signal.

options.label: Replace it with a visitor-facing article directory and write out the full navigation hierarchy
options.feedback: A visible directory is information architecture or site navigation, not a replacement for an XML sitemap. The broken machine URL still needs handling.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请生成 sitemap.xml，只放入希望爬虫发现、使用完整规范 URL 且能正常访问的重要页面。生成后校验 XML 格式，并逐个请求清单里的地址；报告哪些 URL 返回成功，哪些需要修复。不要把 Sitemap 说成收录或排名保证。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Generate sitemap.xml with only important pages that you want crawlers to discover, using full canonical URLs that are reachable. Validate the XML and request every listed address; report which URLs succeed and which need fixing. Do not describe a sitemap as an indexing or ranking guarantee.

learning.assumes: You know that a web page opens through a URL and have heard that search systems crawl and index pages.
learning.outcome: You can decide which reachable canonical URLs belong in sitemap.xml and distinguish discovery, crawling, indexing, and site information architecture.

modules.title: How one URL in the file becomes a crawler request
Which step an XML sitemap supports

items.title: List the addresses you want systems to discover
items.text: A sitemap organizes full URLs in XML for important pages you want crawlers to discover. Each address should exist, be reachable, and match the page's chosen canonical address.

items.title: Discovery is followed by requests and decisions
items.text: After reading the list, a crawler still requests each page, checks access, and decides what to process. A sitemap improves discovery; it does not provide content or decide indexing and ranking.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: An XML sitemap is a machine file for crawlers. An information-architecture sitemap or site navigation is a visible structure for people. It is not access control: listing a URL grants no permission, and omitting one does not block access.
